verdict.rationale: Pipedream's core model is event-triggered automation. It documents triggers for app events, HTTP/webhook, schedule, email and RSS, paired with pre-built actions for thousands of apps and custom code steps. A community user reports an Airtable base that auto-feeds into an Algolia index. missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional rule logic (filters/branching) beyond custom code, and deeper independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
Today, we support the following triggers: Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS
you can use pre-built components when you're performing common actions, but you can write custom code when you need to.
